note: Work deliberately excluded from the index by a prior ruling. auto_curate.py skips the repositories and paper_curate.py skips the DOIs; a drop decision is invisible in data/sdv-index.json, so without this file a bulk pass silently re-adds them. Note that a retired entry (one carrying duplicate_of) is also absent from data/sdv-index.json while its id and url are still owned by a shard, so any filter meant to skip curated work must read data/shards/, not the built index.
